_comment: Baseline hook set for generated teams (rules/hooks-integration.md). Portable: no jq (not preinstalled on stock macOS), every path anchored to CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (bare relative paths created nested .worklog trees in production), non-blocking failures suppressed. session-events.jsonl accumulates the RAW UserPromptSubmit event JSON, one object per line (the user's text is inside the .prompt field — consumers must parse JSON, not expect plain text). Name its consumer in the team CLAUDE.md; teams handling secrets drop that hook or add redaction.

hooks.command: test -d "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.worklog/$(date +%Y%m)" || echo 'WARN: worklog dir missing for this month' >&2
